# Claw Mission Control
> Real-time mission control dashboard for OpenClaw agents, with Convex-backed state and an optional transcript ingestion bridge.

## Core Files
- [README.md]: Setup and project overview
- [docs/index.md]: Documentation entry point
- [src/app/page.tsx]: Main dashboard composition
- [src/components/dashboard/]: UI panels and modals
- [convex/schema.ts]: Data model
- [convex/queries.ts]: Read API
- [convex/mutations.ts]: Write API
- [convex/http.ts]: HTTP ingest endpoint (`/api/openclaw-hook`)
- [bridge/index.ts]: OpenClaw transcript -> Convex bridge
- [infra/cloudflared-config.yml]: Optional tunnel config

## Key Concepts
- Mission queue: Task lifecycle in Kanban (`inbox`, `assigned`, `in_progress`, `review`, `done`)
- Agent registry: Profiles and runtime states (`idle`, `working`, `error`, `offline`)
- Activity stream: Timestamped event feed used for live operations monitoring
- Bridge ingest: Local JSONL transcript scanning and event forwarding to Convex
- Standup snapshot: Daily rollup of completed/in-progress/review/decision items

## Runtime Notes
- Frontend requires `NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL`.
- Bridge requires `CONVEX_SITE_URL`.
- Calendar and global search are currently prototype/mock-data components.
